concerns.text: FR-006 (Dataset Integrity Check) and FR-011 (Semantic Matcher) are covered by T007 and T008, but the plan's Phase 0 T003 (Integrity Check) and Phase 2 T015 (Semantic Matching) are not explicitly mapped to tasks in the 'Foundational' phase. T007/T008 are marked [X] (done), but T015 (Semantic Matching in parsing) is missing a dedicated task in Phase 4 (US2). T060 covers semantic matching but is marked [X] while T059 (Exact string matching) is [ ]. This creates a gap: the plan requires both exact and semantic matching for US2, but the tasks are inconsistent in status and coverage.

FR-003 (Parse CoT traces for first/last constraint) and FR-011 (Semantic equivalence) require tasks T059 and T060. T059 is marked [ ] (rejected/missing) and T060 is [X] (done). However, the plan's Phase 2 T014 (Parsing) and T015 (Semantic Matching) are not fully covered. T059 is critical for FR-003 but is missing implementation. This blocks the entire US2 parsing pipeline.

FR-002 (LLM execution) and FR-009 (6-hour runtime) require tasks T052-T056. T052 is [X] but T053 (Inference loop with timeout), T054 (Error handling), T055 (Memory Guard), and T056 (Write traces) are [ ] (rejected/missing). The plan's Phase 1 T009 (Inference), T010 (Memory Guard), and T011 (Save traces) are not covered by implemented tasks. This leaves the core data generation capability missing.

FR-004 (Error Classification) and FR-005 (Statistical Analysis) require tasks T064-T070. T064 (Classifier logic) is [ ] (rejected), T065 (Stats script) is [ ], T066 (Test Selection) is [ ], T067 (Framing Injection) is [ ], T068 (Multiple Comparison) is [ ], T069 (P-value) is [ ], T070 (Report) is [ ]. The plan's Phase 3 T016-T021 are not covered. This blocks US3 entirely.

FR-010 (Human Validation) and SC-006 (Agreement rate) require tasks T071-T073. T071 (Generate request) is [ ], T072 (Ingest labels) is [ ], T073 (Validate classifier) is [ ]. The plan's Phase 4 T022 is not covered. This leaves the validation step missing.

Plan T023 (Paper sections) and T024 (State update) require tasks T080 and T081. T080 is [ ] (rejected), T081 is [ ] (rejected). Plan T025 (Consistency check) requires T082, which is [ ] (rejected). This leaves the final reporting and validation steps missing.

FR-001 (Dataset download/filter) requires tasks T012-T016. T012 (Download) is [X], T013 (Filtering logic) is [ ], T014 (Integrity check) is [X], T015 (Write filtered) is [X], T016 (CLI args) is [ ]. The plan's Phase 0 T001-T003 are partially covered, but T013 (Filtering logic) is missing, which is critical for FR-001.

Plan Phase 0.5 (Pilot Study) requires tasks T040-T042. T040 (Pilot generation) is [X], T041 (Validate pilot) is [X], T042 (Tune threshold) is [X]. These are covered, but the plan's T005-T007 are not explicitly mapped to these tasks. However, the coverage is sufficient for the pilot study.

Task T006 (YAML schema files) is marked [ ] (rejected) but is required by the plan's Phase 1 contracts. The plan's T001-T003 (Data schemas) are not covered by implemented tasks. This is a writing issue as the task exists but is not implemented.

Task T001 (Project structure) and T003 (Linting) are marked [ ] (rejected) but are required by the plan's Phase 1 setup. The plan's T001 (Download) is covered by T012, but T003 (Linting) is missing. This is a writing issue as the task exists but is not implemented.
